method:
v3.5.2 REV 5 CAD check, J-FWD (lead 16:53Z R2 / R4 = CHANGELOG 243 (4) / (6); CHANGELOG 241 (6) / (8)), on config.V352_R5.
(a) TC-01 rev-5 J-FWD geometry as built, all 10 flats: flat face area and extents in the screw frame (x' radial, y' tangential, z' axial),
    point probes of the flat, the pocket wall, the tangential run-out and the wall to the 57.25 bore; the 15 deg x 3.5 lead-in (C2).
(b) pocket length against the TC-01 forward features: pocket ends (cutter d11.2 modelled; d11.3 maximum on paper) to the fwd end face (datum
    B), the lead-in end and the seal-land end; min distance flat / pocket wall to the end face; ENG-FD-04 (foil, clips) to the pocket faces
    of every hole (the 162 / 198 deg holes lie in its sector).
(c) head raised by the solid spring (t 0.44 / 0.52; head envelope d9.5 x 2.85 from r_flat + t, spring d10.0 x t on the flat) at the screw-axis
    offset 0 and at the method stack toward FD-04 (-z), against every other instance within 3 mm at neutral and the four combined gimbal
    extremes (as test_spring_r4s v1); TC-01 excluded (the spring sits on it).
(d) flat complete under the spring in the axial direction: common volume of the spring envelope (full disc d10.0 x 0.52, conservative) with
    TC-01 at z offsets 0 / 0.328 / the method stack / 0.547 / 0.557 / 0.60 / 0.62, both signs, at two holes (the CAD corner is sharp: contact
    at 0.60; the drawn corner R <= 0.05 makes the paper tolerable e 0.55).
(e) supported area of the spring annulus (OD 10.0 / ID 5.2) on the flat: the annulus face 0.0005 below the flat intersected with TC-01
    (excludes the hole and the tangential run-out), at tangential and axial offsets, on the CAD nominal TC-01 and on a worst-stack tube built
    here (OD 63.426 centred 0.02 away from the hole side, flat at 31.333 from datum A, cutter d11.2, hole 5.62; the 0.1 OD break is not
    modelled): cross-check of spring v3's seg_area table ('without_break' column) and the bearing fraction with the hole excluded.
(f) TC-02 J-FWD tap walls at the clocking tolerance: probe bisection as test_interim352b v1 at az 18 / 342 / 126 / 162 rotated by +/-0.5 and
    +/-1.0 deg (the taps are match-drilled where the TC-01 holes are, so a clocking error moves them in TC-02's frame).
(g) datum B: TC-02 head shoulder to the TC-01 fwd end face, TC-02 plug end to the TC-01 bore step, the hole row from the end face.
(h) the positional stack on the match-drill method (paper; sourced terms) and the ENG-HW-101-IN718 pilot / undercut drawing values.
Software checks, not physical validation.  Mechanical, 2026-10-20.

a_tc01_geometry.flat_area_paper_basis: d11.2 disc truncated at the half chord on the OD, less the d5.5 hole

axial_paper_mm.wall_under_the_flat_note: the flat lies at r_flat from A over its whole area, so the longer pocket keeps the 2.665-2.708 wall; the lead-in (bore side) ends before the pocket starts

sources.ISO286: CADforum 'ISO Tolerances' (ISO 286 tables), https://www.cadforum.cz/en/tolerance.asp, accessed 2026-10-20: 3-6 mm F7 +22/+10, h8 0/-18, h9 0/-30, g6 -4/-12 um
sources.DIN13: GANTER 'Specifications and Extracts from DIN / ISO Standards' 2393, DIN 13 extract, tolerance fields 6g / 6H, https://www.ganternorm.com/fileadmin/user_upload/downloads/technischer%20anhang/technical_information/13_gewinde.pdf, accessed 2026-10-20: M5 6g d 4.976/4.826, d2 4.456/4.361, d1 3.995/3.869; 6H D >= 5.000, D2 4.480/4.605, D1 4.134/4.334
sources.spring_ID: spring v3 inputs (Schnorr brochure 2024-02 p. 10 / Lesjofors 7909: Di 5.2 +0.12/0)

ruled_design_basis_0.328.terms: pilot play 0.100 + hole position 0.050 + spot-face coaxiality 0.050 + tap position 0.050 + fit registration 0.078
ruled_design_basis_0.328.finding: on the match-drill method the 0.328 is not the axial bound: its fit-registration term (the plug f7 / bore H8 radial gap) moves a radial screw along its own axis or tangentially, never along the engine axis; the hole position to A|B does not enter (the flat is coaxial to its own hole); it omits the thread play, the pilot coaxiality and the axial re-registration

full_float_info_mm.terms: screw major 4.826 min against the hole wall 5.62 max ((5.62 - 4.826) / 2 = 0.397) + pilot play + pilot coaxiality + spot-face coaxiality
full_float_info_mm.note: information: a re-assembly with no axial registration (no gauge); spring v3's 0.547 used the hole position in place of the coaxiality and no pilot coaxiality

pilot_and_undercut_HW101_drawing.pilot_length_mm: 0.35-0.40 from the bearing face: centres the spring over most of its thickness (t 0.44-0.52) and ends above the flat at every t, so the TC-01 hole sees only the thread (float 0.397, the rows' basis)
pilot_and_undercut_HW101_drawing.undercut: fillet r 0.2-0.3 recessed into the pilot just below the bearing face, root diameter >= 4.75 (below the thread major minimum 4.826, above the thread minor maximum 3.995: the undercut section 17.72 mm2 at d 4.75 stays larger than the thread stress area A_s 14.18 mm2)
pilot_and_undercut_HW101_drawing.da_basis: the undercut keeps the bearing-face inner edge at the pilot diameter (lead 16:53Z R2: 'State da on our own drawing')
pilot_and_undercut_HW101_drawing.pilot_coaxiality: dia 0.02 to the thread pitch cylinder (PROPOSED, TO-CONFIRM with the maker)

d_spring_rim_vs_pocket_wall.verdict: no common volume up to e 0.60 (CAD sharp corner at the cutter radius 5.6); the drawn corner R <= 0.05 gives the paper tolerable e 0.55; method stack 0.3705 (margin 0.1795), ruled 0.328 (margin 0.222), full float 0.557 (information, -0.007)

worst_stack_tube_basis.note: spring v3 / rows v6 subtract the eccentricity from the OD radius (4.7633); here the OD centre is offset (4.7649): 0.0016 apart; the 0.1 OD break is not modelled

f_tc02_tap_walls_clocking.probe: d 5.0 + 2w from r 28.6 - 9.0 - w to r 28.4 inside the plug envelope (as test_interim352b v1)
f_tc02_tap_walls_clocking.note: add the TC-01 hole position (0.05 radial) and the axial gauge (0.02) arithmetically to any wall read here

g_datum_B.verdict: TC-02 does not seat axially on TC-01 (head shoulder and plug end both clear); the hole row is dimensioned from the TC-01 fwd end face: datum B = the TC-01 fwd end face
